description: This file contains the PHP class Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Checkout\Voucher, which implements a controller for handling voucher functionalities in the checkout process of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class includes methods for displaying the voucher form, adding a voucher, removing a voucher, and handling success scenarios. It interacts with session data, models, and views to manage vouchers during checkout.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for managing checkout vouchers, including displaying voucher form, adding, removing vouchers, and showing success page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the voucher entry form, prepares breadcrumbs, loads necessary models and views, and initializes voucher session data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the adding of a voucher to the session, validating input and voucher data, and returning JSON responses.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a voucher from the session based on a provided key or token, manages session cleanup, and returns JSON responses.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays a success message after a voucher has been successfully applied.
